tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Exam Technique and Preparation

questions.question: Explain the difference between the command words 'describe' and 'evaluate', giving an example of how your answer would differ for each.
questions.correctAnswer: 'Describe' = say what happens or what something is like. E.g. 'PP is a thermoplastic that can be melted and reshaped, is lightweight and chemical-resistant' - factual, no judgement. 'Evaluate' = give both sides AND reach a justified conclusion. E.g. 'PP is lightweight and chemical-resistant (advantage), but cannot withstand high oven temperatures (disadvantage), making it suitable for cold storage

questions.question: A question asks: 'Evaluate the suitability of using polypropylene for a reusable food container.' Write a plan for a full-mark answer.

questions.question: A student writes one-sided answers that only give advantages. Explain why this loses marks and how they should improve.
questions.correctAnswer: Evaluation requires BOTH sides - advantages AND disadvantages - plus a justified conclusion. One-sided answers score maximum half marks because they do not demonstrate AO3. Improvement: always use 'however', 'on the other hand', 'a limitation is' to introduce disadvantages. Then conclude: 'Overall, [material/process] is suitable because [specific reason] despite [acknowledged limitation].'
